en.name: Dulce de leche
en.summary: Dulce de leche is milk and sugar cooked down until it caramelises into a thick spread. An unopened commercial jar or can keeps about 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, about 3–4 weeks refrigerated is the working figure — and homemade versions belong at the short end of that.
en.pantry: Unopened, keep it in a cool dark cupboard for about 12 months from purchase; the jar or can is commercially heat-processed and shelf-stable, and the date on the lid is the real guide. A can that is bulging, leaking or rusted through goes in the bin unopened. Homemade dulce de leche, including the boiled-can version people make at home, is not shelf-stable at all and belongs in the fridge from the moment it cools.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it covered at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and take it out with a clean spoon every time — a buttery knife is what turns a jar mouldy. About 3–4 weeks is our working figure rather than a published one: the canned evaporated and condensed milk line gives 4 to 5 days after opening, and this record extends that because dulce de leche is condensed milk cooked much further, with far more water driven off and a far higher sugar concentration. If you want the conservative answer, use the shorter condensed-milk window. Decant anything left in an opened can into a glass jar; it stiffens to a paste when cold, so stand the jar in warm water rather than microwaving it.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for dulce de leche and freezing it rarely pays. The sugar concentration means it never freezes hard, and what comes back is grainier than what went in. If a jar is outlasting your appetite, use it rather than store it colder — over ice cream, folded into buttercream, spread in an alfajor, or loosened with milk into a sauce.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or around the rim of the jar
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A lid that has domed up, or fizzing on opening
A watery layer separating out that will not stir back in
tips: Use a clean dry spoon; never a knife that has been in the butter.
Decant an opened can into glass straight away.
Warm a cold jar in hot water rather than the microwave, which scorches it.
Treat homemade and boiled-can dulce de leche as a fresh dairy product, not a preserve.

faq.q: Does dulce de leche need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while the commercial jar or can is sealed — about 12 months in a cupboard. After opening, refrigerate it and use it within about 3–4 weeks.

faq.q: How long does homemade dulce de leche last?
faq.a: Treat it as the perishable end of the range: refrigerated from the moment it cools, and eaten well within the opened-jar window.

faq.q: Can you freeze dulce de leche?
faq.a: There is no timeline and little point. The sugar stops it freezing hard and it comes back grainier.

faq.q: Why did my jar of dulce de leche go mouldy?
faq.a: Almost always a used spoon or knife. Crumbs and butter give mould a foothold in an otherwise very sugary, stable food.

zh.name: 牛奶焦糖醬
zh.summary: Dulce de leche 是把牛奶和糖一起熬到焦糖化、變成濃稠抹醬。未開封的市售罐裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後冷藏大約 3～4 週是實用上限——自製的則屬於這個範圍裡最短的一端。
zh.pantry: 未開封請放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12 個月；市售玻璃罐或金屬罐經過加熱處理，可以常溫存放，而蓋子上的日期才是真正的依據。罐身鼓起、滲漏或鏽穿的，不要開，直接丟掉。自製的 dulce de leche，包括在家把整罐煉乳丟進滾水煮的做法，完全不能常溫保存，放涼後就該進冰箱。
zh.fridge: 開封後請加蓋放 4 °C 以下，而且每次都用乾淨的湯匙取用——沾了奶油的刀子正是讓一罐甜醬長霉的原因。大約 3～4 週是我們的實用判斷，不是已發表的數字：罐裝煉乳／蒸發奶的資料給的是開封後 4 到 5 天，而本篇往上延長，因為 dulce de leche 是煉乳再熬得更乾，水分被趕掉更多、糖濃度也高得多。想要保守答案的話，就照煉乳那個較短的窗口走。開過的金屬罐請把剩下的移到玻璃罐；冷藏後會硬得像膏，請把罐子泡溫水回軟，不要用微波爐。
zh.freezer: Dulce de leche 沒有冷凍期限，冷凍通常也不划算。糖度太高讓它凍不硬，解凍後質地反而更粗。一罐吃不完的話，與其冰得更冷，不如把它用掉——淋冰淇淋、拌進奶油霜、夾 alfajor 餅乾，或用牛奶調稀成淋醬。
spoilage: 聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
分離出一層水，而且攪不回去
tips: 用乾淨乾燥的湯匙；絕對不要用沾過奶油的刀。
開過的金屬罐請立刻把內容物移到玻璃罐。
冷藏後的罐子泡熱水回軟，不要微波，微波容易燒焦。
自製和煮罐頭做的，請當成新鮮乳製品而不是保存品。

faq.q: Dulce de leche 一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 市售未開封不用，櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後要冷藏，並在大約 3～4 週內用完。

faq.q: 自製的牛奶焦糖醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 請當成範圍裡最容易壞的一端：放涼就冷藏，並且要遠早於開封罐的上限吃完。

faq.q: 牛奶焦糖醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也沒什麼意義。糖度太高凍不硬，解凍後質地更粗。

faq.q: 我的焦糖醬為什麼長霉了？
faq.a: 幾乎都是用過的湯匙或刀子造成的。麵包屑和奶油讓霉在原本很穩定的高糖食物裡找到立足點。
